India Plans Major Bullet Train Network Expansion

The Union government has announced plans for a significant expansion of the high-speed rail network, including a major corridor connecting Delhi to Siliguri via Varanasi. This initiative, mentioned in the Budget, aims to drastically reduce travel times between major cities. The project is part of a broader strategy to develop multiple high-speed rail routes across the country.
